target.body:
Closes #101

## Summary

- allow exact safe TypeScript session/provider credential source references
- recognize explicit `test-key`, `test-secret`, and `test-token` placeholders
- add unified-diff coverage for added and deleted lines plus negative real-credential cases

## Validation

- `scripts/validate-skills`: 6 skills validated
- repository Python suite: 247 passed, 2 skipped
- Node suite: 32 passed
- all configured autoreview self-tests passed
- candidate integration dry-run: complete downstream branch bundle passed secret scanning without redaction or exclusion
- `git diff --check origin/main...231bc2c8d34d2fbca585e1e67b597dc75623764a`: passed

## Review note

The structured autoreview bundle itself passed validation (3,485 bytes, one pass), but this container could not complete the external model call: the installed Codex CLI received HTTP 401 from the reviewer endpoint. No autoreview cleanliness claim is made; independent review remains required.
